2.descriptionEnUS: 2 pieces: +5% Max HP. Equipping does not restore HP.

knight.descriptionEnUS: 4 pieces: Take 10% less direct enemy damage when blocking a hit.

elf.descriptionEnUS: 4 pieces: Ranged skills deal 5% more direct damage.

dwarf.descriptionEnUS: 4 pieces: Physical skills deal 5% more direct damage.

mage.descriptionEnUS: 4 pieces: Magic skills cost 8% less MP, rounded up to a whole MP.

5.descriptionTemplateEnUS: 5 pieces: Deal {percent}% more direct damage with basic attacks and skills.

calculationPolicy.outgoingDamage: post-target-mitigation-direct-damage * (1 + eligible-four-piece-fraction) * (1 + five-piece-fraction); round once at the end
calculationPolicy.blockedDamage: normal-block-direct-enemy-damage-after-flat-armor * (1 - knight-four-piece-fraction), before shields; preserve minimum-damage rule
calculationPolicy.magicCost: positive-base-cost -> max(1, ceil(base-cost * (1 - mage-four-piece-fraction))); zero cost stays zero
calculationPolicy.eligibleAttacks: basic attacks and server-confirmed active skill hits, including eligible ultimate and authored pulses once each
calculationPolicy.uniqueProcInteraction: do not multiply proc-generated bonus damage by set multipliers again
